newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin gets Clinton congratulations, talks to Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Jospin gets Clinton congratulations, talks to Kohl.

text.p: French Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin has received a warm letter of congratulations from U.S. President Bill Clinton and has talked with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl since his appointment, aides said on Wednesday.
They said Clinton voiced the will to work with Jospin and hoped that they would meet shortly in what they described as a particularly warm letter of congratulations.

Jospin has talked on the telephone with Kohl since he was appointed by conservative President Jacques Chirac on Monday, a day after Jospin defeated Chirac's allies in a snap parliamentary election, the aides said. They did not elaborate.

Kohl dropped plans to travel to Paris on Wednesday to address the parliamentary assembly of the Western European Union because of a dispute with the Bundesbank over plans to revalue Germany's gold reserves.
The German leader earlier cabled congratulations to Jospin, saying he was sure their two countries would continue to work closely together.

Kohl and Jospin, along with Chirac, are due to meet at a regular Franco-German summit on June 13 in Poitiers in western France. Jospin is also expected to attend a European Union summit in Amsterdam on June 16-17.
